result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position because it omits the absolute prohibition on Vendor assignments to a Customer competitor. More importantly, unchanged clause (c) appears to continue requiring Garman’s written authorization for assignment of the Agreement, conflicting with Sparkling’s new affiliate and successor carve-outs in clause (d). The added prohibition on re-pricing also goes beyond the stated requirement, which addresses only termination upon Customer change of control. Although the reasonableness standard and Customer M&A carve-out are directionally correct, the operative language is internally inconsistent and overreaches in one respect.
